text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Erlang
        uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          otp-version: "26.2"
          rebar3-version: "3.22.1"

      - name: Run tests
        run: rebar3 eunit ct

      - name: Build release
        run: rebar3 release

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: _build/default/rel/nova/releases/*/*.tar.gz
          generate_release_notes: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
